transactions.name: poll-submit-wait-read
transactions.description: A foreground transfer polls readiness, submits one word, waits for completion, then consumes the result.

interference.reason: The SVD marks this read as clearing the synthetic READY event.
The handler consumes the pending data word before the foreground result read.
The handler changes the START control bit during the foreground transaction.

transactions.name: configure-and-acknowledge
transactions.description: Match exact command values in a two-event foreground transaction and distinguish the timer configuration overwrite from a disjoint W1C acknowledgement.

interference.reason: The timer handler replaces the ordinary configuration word with a different constant.
The USART handler clears a disjoint W1C event bit.
